notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) only - direct HTTP GET (curl, Chrome UA) worked cleanly for every page; robots.txt (User-agent: * / Allow: / with only a few Disallow paths, none relevant) did not block. Never needed Playwright or Claude-in-Chrome. TREE: built from union of (1) sitemap_index.xml -> sitemap_0.xml (full URL list, ~2650 URLs, mostly /pdp/ product pages plus ~280 category/content URLs), (2) the site's SFCC mega-menu on the homepage and each department landing page (Living, Dining, Bedroom, Office, Home Decor, Rugs, Outdoor, Workroom), (3) each category page's own breadcrumb/sub-nav and category-id hidden input. Site is Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware); category pages expose a hidden 'Search-UpdateGrid' AJAX endpoint (on/demandware.store/.../Search-UpdateGrid?cgid=<id>&start=0&sz=N) used only for counting, not navigation discovery. QTY: SFCC pages use a 'Load More' infinite-scroll grid (default 24/page) - the schema.org ItemList numberOfItems in the initial HTML only reflects the first page and is NOT the true total, so it was not trusted. True qty obtained by exhaustion: called Search-UpdateGrid with sz=1000 for the page's own category-id and counted unique /pdp/ product URLs; verified stable (unchanged) versus sz=200/500 re-checks on a sample category before trusting the method site-wide. EXCLUDED - Textile: home-decor/window-treatments (h1 'Window Treatments' but page has no category-id/product grid at all - a Page Designer content/landing page, not a real listing - excluded as a non-listing page per View-All/Collection rule). rugs/rug-pads (qty 4, textile.md does not list rug pads and they are a functional non-slip accessory analogous to excluded curtain-rod hardware, not a fabric/rug product themselves - excluded). bedroom/bedding/accent-pillows and bedroom/bedding/throws were dropped as near-duplicates of home-decor/accent-pillows (219 vs 217 products, 213 shared) and home-decor/throws (27 vs 23 products, 22 shared) reached via a different nav path to essentially the same catalog category - kept the Home Decor instance only, per duplicate-prevention rule. living/true-custom-upholstery, dining/order-swatches, office/order-swatches, workroom/leather are fabric-swatch/leather-material configurator pages for building custom furniture, not standalone home-textile product listings - excluded. Sitemap URLs bedroom/rugs, dining/performance-rugs, office/rugs, outdoor/outdoor-rugs, home-decor/bedding all 301-redirect to canonical pages already captured (rugs, rugs/performance-rugs, rugs, rugs/outdoor-rugs, bedroom/bedding respectively) - not separate nodes. EXCLUDED - Storage: no genuine storage/organization category exists on this site (no storage boxes/baskets/bins/organizers/closet systems found anywhere in the sitemap or nav). The only nav items literally labelled 'Storage' - office/storage ('Home Office Storage Cabinets and Credenzas', cgid=storage) and dining/storage-and-sideboards ('Dining Room Sideboards and Cabinets', cgid=storage-sideboards) - were inspected product-by-product: both are dominated by credenzas, sideboards, bookcases, etageres, display cabinets and chests (classic furniture case-goods, storage.md Sec.21/16/27 furniture-boundary examples), with only one or two incidental storage-purpose items (a file cabinet, a storage cart) mixed in. Judged as Furniture (already covered by the validated Furniture.xlsx), not genuine Storage/organization products, and excluded from storage_rows. bedroom/storage-beds, bedroom/dressers-and-chests(+chests,+dressers) are beds/dressers/chests - clearly Furniture, excluded. home-decor/cabinet-hardware(+knobs,+pulls) is hardware, not storage. home-decor/wall-decor/wall-basket-decor is decorative wall decor, not a storage product. Result: storage_rows is empty - Bassett Furniture (a furniture manufacturer) has no dedicated home-organization/storage product line.
